name: Toudou Koyori
source:
Koyori is a first-year student and the vivacious younger sister of [url=/c4747]Tsumugi[/url], second oldest to [url=/c4758]Kasane[/url]. An animated, headstrong, tenacious and often loud girl, Koyori, much like [url=/c4742]Ibuki[/url], does not welcome [url=/c4750]Kazuma[/url] with open arms at the start of their introduction, though after cushioning her fall from a tree she has a change of heart. In spite of her almost spitfire disposition, Koyori enjoys helping others and appreciates those who help her.

[From [url=http://www.http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Hoshizora_e_Kakaru_Hashi_characters]Wikipedia[/url]]
